mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 320 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 320.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% and rise in residential sales (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals a robust labor market and strong housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and RSAFS > 700000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% in late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the dual pressures.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST above 1600 thousand units), elevated housing construction signals potential overbuilding and a subsequent correction in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the correction spreads to the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1600 thousand units.
